name: Skyr (Icelandic Yogurt)
siboNotes: Contains lactose which can feed bacterial overgrowth. Those with severe lactose intolerance should limit portions or choose lactose-free alternatives.
preparationTips: Choose plain varieties to avoid added high-FODMAP sweeteners
Start with smaller portions to assess tolerance
Consider taking lactase enzyme if lactose sensitive
Mix with low-FODMAP fruits like strawberries or kiwi
alternatives: Hard cheeses like cheddar or Swiss
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in probiotics for gut health
